holidays.name: Sourest Day
holidays.description: Pucker up! This tangy observance invites you to celebrate everything sour, from lemon wedges and warheads to pickles and sour cream. Dare a friend to a sour candy challenge and watch the faces.
holidays.origin: Sourest Day is an unofficial observance of unclear origin, and it has become a favorite among candy fans and pickle lovers.
holidays.funFact: Sour tastes come from acids, and humans likely evolved to detect them as a warning sign for unripe or spoiled food. Plenty of us now seek that mouth-puckering jolt on purpose.

holidays.name: World Pasta Day
holidays.description: A global carb-loving party honoring spaghetti, penne, fusilli and every noodle shape in between. Cook up a big bowl, try a new regional sauce, or finally master fresh pasta from scratch.
holidays.origin: World Pasta Day grew out of the first World Pasta Congress, held in Rome in 1995. The pasta industry has promoted it each year since to celebrate the dish and its place in cuisines around the world.
holidays.funFact: Italy has hundreds of documented pasta shapes, and many are named for everyday things. Vermicelli means little worms, and orecchiette means little ears.
